purpose: Frozen contract that the Phase 2 20-agent fan-out builds against. All fragment authors and glossary curators MUST honour this contract — the fragment-registry and fragment-selector at runtime assume its invariants.

sourceTier.humanInterpretation: This file is a contract / spec document. It mentions training_derived sourceType because Phase 2 fragments are AI-derived; this contract itself is metadata, not narrative prose. Marked T1_HYPOTHESIS so the no-ai-policy gate can verify the marker chain end-to-end.
sourceTier.copyrightNote: No source prose copied; original contract.

fragmentIdConvention.format: <category>.<period>.<depth>.<gating-keys>.<NNN>  (each <segment> matches [a-z0-9_]+ per the narrative-fragment schema regex; strength labels lowercased, ageBand uses 30_39 not 30-39, trailing NNN is a 3-digit sequence — Phase 2 wave A authored under this convention)

ownership.comment: Each category prefix is owned by exactly one Phase 2 agent. ID space is partitioned to avoid collision. Agent 0 (this contract) owns no prefix; agents 1-10 own one category each; specialized agents 11-15 own auxiliary prefixes (_glossary/, _metaphor/, _modifier_gender/, _modifier_age/, _overall_pool/).

fallbackChain.comment: Fragment selection fallback priority. When no fragment matches all gating fields, the selector relaxes the LEFTMOST dimension first (gender wildcard, then ageBand wildcard, ...). If even after full relaxation no fragment matches, the cell becomes meaningfulness:'na', stars:null. This is also the priority list the agents must respect when authoring overlapping coverage.

slotResolution.comment: At build time, each slot is resolved against either the fragment's own slots dict (variant pool — pick one via selectionSeed hash) OR the saju feature vector (e.g., {kind:'slot',name:'periodLabel',type:'periodLabel'} resolves to '올해 (2026년)' from the period meta).

tagTokens.comment: Each kind:'tag' token MUST reference a glossary id present in data/narrative/_glossary/<id>.json. The fragment-registry validates this at load time; missing ids fail the narrative-schema test.

numericalEvidence.comment: Expert fragments may attach deterministic numeric backing. valueExpression is a safe path, not JavaScript.
numericalEvidence.runtimeBehavior: Non-numeric values, unsafe expressions, and malformed sourceTier rows are omitted from ExpertFortuneText.numericalEvidence.

voiceRubric.tonePolicy: All Korean prose uses the ~해요/~에요 endings (consistent with existing card builders). Avoid ~다 / ~한다 (formal-academic) unless explicitly inside expert tier and clearly framed as a doctrinal quote.

brief.intent: Initial school / middle-school readability. 1-2 sentences max plus optional hook. No tags allowed (tags appear only in expert tier). Headline ≤ 28 Korean characters.
brief.exampleHook: 큰 무리수만 피하면 든든히 모을 수 있어요.

standard.intent: User-friendly multi-paragraph. ~3-7 paragraphs. Use everyday metaphors (오행 → 식물/날씨/요리 etc). Provide ≥1 living tip and ≥1 caution where applicable. No inline tags.

expert.intent: Classical / academic reasoning anchored on inline #tags. Numbers are optional but when present must come from the deterministic feature vector (not invented). 4-8 paragraphs typical.
expert.tagDensity: Aim for 2-6 tag tokens per paragraph; never more than 1 tag per ~30 characters.

metaphorLibrary.comment: Anchor metaphor families per element. Phase 2 agent-12 (metaphor library) expands these. Phase 1 placeholder fragments may use them directly.

noAiPolicy.isolationRule: src/calculator/**, src/saju-*.ts, src/spring-engine.ts, src/spring-evaluator.ts MUST NOT import data/narrative/** or src/report/tiered/**. Enforced by tiered-isolation-guard.test.ts.

selectionSeed.comment: Deterministic fragment pick. Hash inputs strictly in this order; same input → same fragment.
selectionSeed.algorithm: FNV-1a 32-bit on UTF-8 of joined inputs; pick = hash mod len(candidates).

categoryAgents.deliverable: data/narrative/<category>/<period>/<depth>.fragments.json — minimum 1 fragment per (period × depth) cell, recommended 5-10 per cell to maximize gating coverage.

specializedAgents.agent-16-qa: Coverage matrix check, fragment ID collision detector.
